text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate a NEW photorealistic clothing-library product photograph inspired by the described reference, not a copy of a screenshot. Pure opaque white #FFFFFF seamless background, bright soft frontal studio lighting, minimal soft contact shadow, crisp realistic fabric texture, true garment colors, no dramatic shadows. Portrait 2:3 canvas, complete centered objects with generous clear margin. Front-facing straight camera. No people, skin, head, neck, hands, legs, body, visible mannequin, stand, hanger, room, typography, logos, brand marks, watermarks, borders or collage. ONE isolated accessory product only: One long black silk tie with narrow diagonal charcoal silver stripes, loosely knotted. Large centered catalog object, realistic material texture and precise polished construction. No clothes, no wearing body or mannequin, no outfit, no additional props. A matched pair or integral components of the same product are allowed only when explicitly described.
